title: A Gaussian Process State Space Formulation for Materials Constitutive Modeling: Application to Quasi-brittle Materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.33175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constitutive models for history-dependent, path-dependent materials typically encode this dependence in prescribed functional forms through internal variables such as damage or plastic strain that are phenomenological, model-dependent, and not directly observable. These rigid forms lack flexibility to match observations, make calibration potentially non-unique, and complicate uncertainty quantification. This paper develops a Gaussian-process state-space model (GP-SSM) that replaces the fixed form of the constitutive model with a flexible GP regression, and the prescribed internal variables with latent state variables learned directly from observable stress-strain histories. As a GP, the model is naturally endowed with a measure of uncertainty and can be constrained to satisfy physical principles. translated_title: 用于材料本构建模的高斯过程状态空间方法：在准脆性材料中的应用
translated_abstract: 针对具有历史相关性和路径相关性的材料，其本构模型通常通过损伤或塑性应变等内部变量，将这种依赖关系编码在预先设定的函数形式中，这些内部变量是唯象的、依赖于具体模型的，且无法直接观测。这些僵化的形式缺乏拟合观测数据的灵活性，可能导致标定结果不唯一，并使不确定性量化变得复杂。本文提出了一种高斯过程状态空间模型（GP-SSM），用灵活的高斯过程回归替代固定形式的本构模型，并用直接从可观测的应力-应变历史中学习得到的潜在状态变量替代预先设定的内部变量。作为一种高斯过程，该模型天然地具备不确定性度量，并且可以通过约束使其满足物理原理。我们在三轴压缩条件下的准脆性材料上演示了这一框架，其中潜在变量的演化由约束条件驱动（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种高斯过程状态空间模型，用灵活的高斯过程回归和从应力-应变历史中学习的潜在状态变量取代传统固定形式的本构模型与唯象内部变量，实现了准脆性材料在三轴压缩下的本构建模与不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Gaussian process state-space model that replaces rigid constitutive forms and phenomenological internal variables with flexible GP regression and latent state variables learned directly from stress-strain histories, demonstrated on quasi-brittle materials under triaxial compression with inherent uncertainty quantification.
